FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode

SELECT s.School, s.Phone
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
  AND s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND sat.NumGE1500 = (
      SELECT MAX(sat2.NumGE1500)
      FROM schools AS s2
      JOIN satscores AS sat2 ON sat2.cds = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOCType = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
        AND s2.School IS NOT NULL
  );

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT sc.School, sc.District, sc.County, sat.AvgScrWrite
  FROM schools AS sc
  JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = sc.CDSCode
  WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Closed'
    AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS score_rank
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT School, District, County, AvgScrWrite
FROM ranked
WHERE score_rank = 2
ORDER BY School;

WITH target_county AS (
    SELECT `County Name` AS county_name
    FROM frpm
    WHERE CDSCode = '01612590125716'
),
eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`County Name` AS county_name,
        ROUND(f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 2) AS free_meal_pct,
        ROUND(f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 2) AS frpm_pct,
        f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS charter
    FROM frpm AS f
    WHERE f.`County Name` = (SELECT county_name FROM target_county)
      AND f.`Low Grade` <> 'P'
      AND f.`High Grade` <> 'P'
      AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
      AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
      AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
),
school_sat AS (
    SELECT
        cds,
        AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite AS sat_score
    FROM satscores
    WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    e.county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(e.free_meal_pct), 2) AS avg_free_meal_percentage,
    ROUND(AVG(e.frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(ss.sat_score), 2) AS avg_sat_score
FROM eligible_schools AS e
LEFT JOIN school_sat AS ss ON ss.cds = e.CDSCode
GROUP BY e.county_name;

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.County AS county,
    s.District AS district,
    s.City AS city,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS k12_enrollment,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS k12_frpm_eligible_count,
    printf('%!.17g', f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS k12_frpm_eligible_percentage,
    t.NumTstTakr AS sat_test_takers,
    t.AvgScrRead AS sat_average_reading_score,
    t.AvgScrMath AS sat_average_math_score,
    t.AvgScrWrite AS sat_average_writing_score,

LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.CDSCode = '01612590137943';

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count,
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS frpm_share,
        ss.NumTstTakr,
        ss.AvgScrRead,
        ss.AvgScrMath,
        ss.AvgScrWrite,
        ss.NumGE1500
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100
      AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
      AND COALESCE(s.Charter, 0) = 0
),
max_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(frpm_count) AS value
    FROM eligible
),
min_share AS (
    SELECT MIN(frpm_share) AS value
    FROM eligible
    WHERE frpm_share IS NOT NULL
),
picks AS (
    SELECT 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, *
    FROM eligible
    WHERE frpm_count = (SELECT value FROM max_count)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'smallest FRPM share' AS part, *
    FROM eligible
    WHERE frpm_share = (SELECT value FROM min_share)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'the CDS code from my notes' AS part, *
    FROM eligible
    WHERE CDSCode = '04615150435602'
)
SELECT
    part,
    School AS school_name,
    County AS county,
    City AS city,
    MailStreet AS mailing_street,
    MailCity AS mailing_city,
    MailState AS mailing_state,
    MailZip AS mailing_ZIP,
    Website AS website,
    enrollment AS "K-12 enrollment",
    frpm_count AS "FRPM-eligible student count",
    frpm_share AS "FRPM share",
    AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite AS "average total SAT score",
    100.0 * NumGE1500 / NULLIF(NumTstTakr, 0) AS "percentage scoring 1500 or more",
    OpenDate AS opening_date,
    CASE WHEN ClosedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status

SELECT f."County Name", COUNT(DISTINCT f.CDSCode) AS qualifying_schools
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN satscores AS s
  ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0
GROUP BY f."County Name"
ORDER BY qualifying_schools DESC, f."County Name" ASC;

JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.City IS NOT NULL
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Provision 2'

SELECT id
FROM cards
WHERE frameEffects LIKE '%extendedart%'
  AND (cardKingdomId IS NULL OR cardKingdomFoilId IS NULL);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_printings,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.uuid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS french_printings,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.uuid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT uuid

    WHERE language = 'French'
) f ON f.uuid = c.uuid

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.code) AS count

JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code

SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS years_between
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'

WITH chosen AS (
    SELECT s.code, s.name
    FROM sets AS s
    WHERE s.code = (
        SELECT c.setCode
        FROM cards AS c
        JOIN sets AS printed_set ON printed_set.code = c.setCode
        WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
        ORDER BY printed_set.releaseDate ASC, printed_set.code ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )

    UNION

    SELECT code, name
    FROM sets
    ORDER BY releaseDate DESC, code ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    chosen.name AS set_name,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN cards.manaCost IS NOT NULL
                     AND cards.convertedManaCost <= 3
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) / COUNT(cards.id),
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM chosen
JOIN cards ON cards.setCode = chosen.code
GROUP BY chosen.code, chosen.name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'white'

SELECT COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Fireball';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Erica Yang'

SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1
  AND frameVersion = (
    SELECT frameVersion

    WHERE frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
    ORDER BY CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  AND otherFaceIds IS NOT NULL

WITH jp_cards AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.uuid, f.name AS japanese_name, c.type AS english_type
    FROM cards c
    JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE lower(c.watermark) = 'boros'
      AND f.language = 'Japanese'
),
card_printings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        j.japanese_name,
        j.english_type,
        c.uuid
    FROM jp_cards j
    JOIN foreign_data f
      ON f.name = j.japanese_name
     AND f.language = 'Japanese'
    JOIN cards c
      ON c.uuid = f.uuid
     AND c.type = j.english_type
),
ruling_totals AS (
    SELECT
        p.japanese_name,
        p.english_type,
        COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_total
    FROM card_printings p
    LEFT JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = p.uuid
    GROUP BY p.japanese_name, p.english_type
)
SELECT japanese_name, english_type, ruling_total
FROM ruling_totals
ORDER BY japanese_name, english_type;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_printings
FROM cards
WHERE CAST(power AS REAL) > 3
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) <= 10;

SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS printings
FROM foreign_data
WHERE language NOT IN ('Ancient Greek', 'Arabic', 'Hebrew', 'Latin', 'Sanskrit', 'Phyrexian')
GROUP BY language
ORDER BY printings ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name)
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.colors = 'B'
  AND instr(',' || c.types || ',', ',Artifact,') > 0
  AND f.language IS NOT NULL
  AND lower(f.language) NOT IN ('english', 'unknown')
  AND f.flavorText IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(f.flavorText) <> '';

SELECT DISTINCT ph.UserId
FROM postHistory AS ph
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = ph.PostId
WHERE p.ViewCount >= 1000

GROUP BY ph.UserId, ph.PostId

WITH posts_2012 AS (
    SELECT Id, Score, LastEditorUserId
    FROM posts
    WHERE CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
),
germany_editors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.Id, u.Reputation
    FROM posts_2012 AS p
    JOIN users AS u
      ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE WHEN u.Location LIKE '%Germany%' THEN p.Score ELSE 0 END
    ), 0) AS germany_last_editor_post_score,
    COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE WHEN u.Id IS NULL OR u.Location IS NULL OR u.Location NOT LIKE '%Germany%'
             THEN p.Score ELSE 0 END
    ), 0) AS other_post_score,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM germany_editors) AS germany_editor_user_count,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Reputation), 0) FROM germany_editors)
        AS germany_editor_combined_reputation

LEFT JOIN users AS u
  ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId;

SELECT SUM(p.Score) AS total_score
FROM postLinks AS pl
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = pl.PostId

    SELECT Id
    FROM posts
    WHERE Title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
)

SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation
FROM users
WHERE Location LIKE '%CA%'
  AND (Location LIKE '%CA,%' OR Location LIKE '%, CA' OR Location LIKE '%, CA,%')
  AND Views = (
    SELECT MAX(Views)
    FROM users
    WHERE Location LIKE '%CA%'
      AND (Location LIKE '%CA,%' OR Location LIKE '%, CA' OR Location LIKE '%, CA,%')
  );

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT p.Id, p.Title, COUNT(pl.Id) AS related_count
    FROM posts AS p
    LEFT JOIN postLinks AS pl ON pl.PostId = p.Id
    WHERE p.Title LIKE '%principal component scores%'
    GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title
)
SELECT Title, related_count
FROM counts
WHERE related_count = (SELECT MAX(related_count) FROM counts);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Reputation), 2)
FROM users AS u
WHERE u.Location = 'India'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
      AND p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
  );

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_2013
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date >= '201301'
      AND y.Date < '201401'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        CustomerID,
        total_2013,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Segment
            ORDER BY total_2013, CustomerID
        ) AS rn
    FROM customer_totals
),
minima AS (
    SELECT Segment, total_2013
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN total_2013 END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN total_2013 END),
        2
    ) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN total_2013 END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN total_2013 END),
        2
    ) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN total_2013 END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN total_2013 END),
        2
    ) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM minima;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(Consumption), 2) AS average_monthly_fuel_consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = 15621
  AND Date LIKE '2013%'
  AND Consumption > 0;

WITH customer_year AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date >= '201201' AND Date <= '201212'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
currency_averages AS (
    SELECT c.Currency, AVG(cy.total_consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM customer_year cy
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = cy.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
    GROUP BY c.Currency
)
SELECT ROUND(
    MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN avg_consumption END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN avg_consumption END)
) AS difference
FROM currency_averages;

WITH extremes AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
    UNION
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
),
average_finishing AS (
    SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing
    FROM Player p
    JOIN extremes e ON e.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
)
SELECT player_name
FROM average_finishing
ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    (SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control)
     FROM Player p
     JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo')
    -
    (SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control)
     FROM Player p
     JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye')
    AS mean_ball_control_difference;

SELECT MIN(pa.date)
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
    FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
    JOIN Player AS p2 ON p2.player_api_id = pa2.player_api_id
    WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  );

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    player_api_id,
    volleys,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_api_id
      ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = r.player_api_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND p.height > 180
  AND r.volleys > 70;

WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM "Match"
),
counts AS (
    SELECT c.name AS country, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_player_appearances
    FROM appearances a
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = a.player_api_id
    JOIN Country c ON c.id = a.country_id
    WHERE p.weight <= 160
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT country, qualifying_player_appearances
FROM counts
WHERE qualifying_player_appearances = (
    SELECT MIN(qualifying_player_appearances) FROM counts
)
ORDER BY country;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        pa.player_api_id,
        pa.overall_rating,
        pa.defensive_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id
            ORDER BY pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
    WHERE pa.date <= '2013-07-12 00:00:00'
),
ratings AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, overall_rating
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
),
average_rating AS (
    SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_rating
    FROM ratings
),
donovan AS (
    SELECT r.overall_rating
    FROM ratings AS r
    JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = r.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (donovan.overall_rating - average_rating.avg_rating)
    / average_rating.avg_rating,
    2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM donovan
CROSS JOIN average_rating;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id)
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  AND t.k_symbol IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM trans AS t
      WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
        AND t.bank = 'AB'
  );

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_salary,
  COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
  );

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
  FROM client AS c
  JOIN district AS home_d
    ON home_d.district_id = c.district_id
  JOIN disp AS owner_disp
    ON owner_disp.client_id = c.client_id
   AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
  WHERE home_d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM disp AS any_disp
      JOIN card AS ca
        ON ca.disp_id = any_disp.disp_id
      WHERE any_disp.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
    )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_district_salary
FROM qualifying_districts AS qd
JOIN district AS d
  ON d.district_id = qd.district_id;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS household_payments,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND t.k_symbol <> 'SIPO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_purpose_payments
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.amount > 4000;

WITH card_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.type AS card_type, cl.district_id, di.A4 AS inhabitants
  FROM card ca
  JOIN disp dp ON ca.disp_id = dp.disp_id
  JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id
  JOIN district di ON cl.district_id = di.district_id
  WHERE ca.type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT card_type, district_id, inhabitants,
         MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY card_type) AS min_inhabitants
  FROM card_districts
)
SELECT card_type, district_id, inhabitants
FROM ranked
WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants
ORDER BY card_type, district_id;

WITH withdrawal_totals AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
district_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population,
        wt.total_withdrawn,
        1.0 * wt.total_withdrawn / CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
        COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN withdrawal_totals AS wt ON wt.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, wt.total_withdrawn
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    region,
    population,
    total_withdrawn,
    ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant_rank,
    ROUND(avg_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM district_metrics
ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant_rank, district_name;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN bank IS NOT NULL AND account IS NOT NULL
            THEN bank || ':' || account
        END) AS external_counterparties
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    ga.account_id,
    di.A2 AS district_name,
    di.A3 AS region,
    COALESCE(tt.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
    COALESCE(tt.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(lc.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
    COALESCE(tt.external_counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparties,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY COALESCE(tt.external_counterparties, 0) DESC
    ) AS counterparty_rank
FROM gold_accounts AS ga
JOIN account AS a ON ga.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_totals AS tt ON ga.account_id = tt.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_counts AS lc ON ga.account_id = lc.account_id
ORDER BY counterparty_rank, ga.account_id;

SELECT 'young cohort' AS cohort, ROUND(AVG(d.A11)) AS average_district_salary
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date >= '1980-01-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'old cohort' AS cohort, ROUND(AVG(d.A11)) AS average_district_salary
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date <= '1919-12-31';

WITH race_winners AS (
  SELECT raceId, laps AS winner_laps
  FROM results
  WHERE positionOrder = 1
),
japanese_entries AS (
  SELECT res.laps, rw.winner_laps
  FROM results AS res
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
  JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = res.raceId
  JOIN race_winners AS rw ON rw.raceId = res.raceId
  WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese'
    AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN laps = winner_laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  2
) AS percentage
FROM japanese_entries;

SELECT
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM lapTimes AS l
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY l.driverId
ORDER BY MIN(l.milliseconds) ASC, full_name ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url AS wikipedia_page_link,
    d.dob AS date_of_birth,
    COUNT(q.q3) AS q3_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q
    ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob >= '1971-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1986-01-01'
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob, q.q1
FROM races r
JOIN qualifying q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q1 <> ''
  AND q.q1 = (
      SELECT MAX(q2.q1)
      FROM qualifying q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = r.raceId
        AND q2.q1 IS NOT NULL
        AND q2.q1 <> ''
  );

WITH qualifying_times AS (
    SELECT d.nationality, q.q1
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE r.year = 1995
      AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
      AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT nationality
FROM qualifying_times
WHERE q1 = (SELECT MIN(q1) FROM qualifying_times);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT other.driverId) AS count
FROM qualifying AS lucas_q
JOIN races AS r
  ON r.raceId = lucas_q.raceId
JOIN qualifying AS other
  ON other.raceId = lucas_q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2010
  AND lucas_q.driverId = (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    WHERE forename = 'Lucas' AND surname = 'di Grassi'
  )
  AND other.driverId <> lucas_q.driverId
  AND lucas_q.position < other.position;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> '\N'
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
  ) < 100;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(q3_counts.q3_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_q3_lap_times
FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(q3) AS q3_count
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 <> '\\N'
    GROUP BY driverId
) q3_counts ON q3_counts.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1981-01-01' AND d.dob < '1992-01-01';

SELECT d.code, q.q3 AS fastest_q3_time
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
    FROM qualifying AS q2
    WHERE q2.raceId = r.raceId
      AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

SELECT d.number AS permanent_race_number, d.surname
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
    + CAST(substr(q.q3, -3) AS REAL) / 1000
  ) < 98;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS withdrew_count
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
WHERE ra.year = 1962
  AND ra.name = 'British Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Withdrew';

SELECT 1.0 * y.amount / o.amount AS ratio
FROM budget AS y
JOIN event AS ey ON ey.event_id = y.link_to_event
JOIN budget AS o
JOIN event AS eo ON eo.event_id = o.link_to_event
WHERE lower(ey.event_name) = 'yearly kickoff'
  AND lower(eo.event_name) = 'october meeting'
  AND lower(y.category) = 'advertisement'
  AND lower(o.category) = 'advertisement';

WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        SUM(b.spent) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS spending_budget_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE LOWER(e.status) = 'closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
)
SELECT event_name
FROM event_ratios
WHERE spending_budget_ratio = (
    SELECT MAX(spending_budget_ratio)
    FROM event_ratios
);

WITH college_majors AS (
    SELECT major_id, major_name, department
    FROM major
    WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
department_totals AS (
    SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS major_count
    FROM college_majors
    GROUP BY department
),
held_majors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cm.department, cm.major_name
    FROM college_majors cm
    JOIN "member" m ON m.link_to_major = cm.major_id
),
held_by_department AS (
    SELECT department, GROUP_CONCAT(major_name, ', ') AS held_majors
    FROM (
        SELECT department, major_name
        FROM held_majors
        ORDER BY department, major_name
    )
    GROUP BY department
),
member_counts AS (
    SELECT cm.department, COUNT(m.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM college_majors cm
    LEFT JOIN "member" m ON m.link_to_major = cm.major_id
    GROUP BY cm.department
)
SELECT
    d.department,
    (
        SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(major_name, ', ')
        FROM (
            SELECT major_name
            FROM college_majors cm
            WHERE cm.department = d.department
            ORDER BY major_name
        )
    ) AS majors_offered,
    COALESCE(h.held_majors, '') AS majors_held,
    ROUND(1.0 * c.member_count / d.major_count, 2) AS average_members_per_major
FROM department_totals d
JOIN member_counts c ON c.department = d.department
LEFT JOIN held_by_department h ON h.department = d.department
ORDER BY d.department;

WITH events_2019 AS (
    SELECT event_id, type
    FROM event
    WHERE event_date >= '2019-01-01'
      AND event_date < '2020-01-01'
),
attendance_by_type AS (
    SELECT e.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS members_attended
    FROM events_2019 AS e
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
),
budget_by_type AS (
    SELECT e.type, COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS total_budgeted_amount
    FROM events_2019 AS e
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT a.type AS event_type,
       a.members_attended,
       b.total_budgeted_amount
FROM attendance_by_type AS a
JOIN budget_by_type AS b ON b.type = a.type
ORDER BY a.type;

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_dues
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.link_to_member
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    WHERE e.event_name LIKE '%Football%'
) AS attendees
JOIN income AS i ON i.link_to_member = attendees.link_to_member
WHERE i.source = 'Dues';

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, MAX(b.amount) AS largest_line
    FROM event e
    JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM expense x
        JOIN budget bx ON bx.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
        WHERE bx.link_to_event = e.event_id
          AND LOWER(x.expense_description) LIKE '%chip%'
    )
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
)
SELECT event_name
FROM eligible
WHERE largest_line = (SELECT MAX(largest_line) FROM eligible);

SELECT e.expense_description, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE LOWER(b.category) = 'food'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY record_count DESC, e.expense_description COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
    JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
    WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(CAST(h.height_cm AS REAL)) AS average_height_cm
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = h.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND h.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id = h.id
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM superhero AS d
        JOIN publisher AS dp ON dp.id = d.publisher_id
        JOIN hero_power AS dhp ON dhp.hero_id = d.id
        WHERE dp.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
          AND dhp.power_id = hp.power_id
      )
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad');

SELECT g.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS hero_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON g.id = s.gender_id
JOIN colour c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
WHERE LOWER(c.colour) = 'blue'
  AND LOWER(g.gender) IN ('male', 'female')
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id)
    FROM hero_power hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
  ) >= 10
GROUP BY g.gender;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS avg_superpowers_per_hero
FROM (
  SELECT s.id, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
  JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
  LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
  WHERE r.race IN ('God', 'Eternal')
    AND g.gender = 'Male'
  GROUP BY s.id
);

WITH race_counts AS (
    SELECT r.race, COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
    FROM superhero h
    JOIN race r ON r.id = h.race_id
    WHERE h.publisher_id = (
        SELECT publisher_id
        FROM superhero
        WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
    )
      AND h.race_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.race
)
SELECT race, superhero_count
FROM race_counts
WHERE superhero_count = (SELECT MAX(superhero_count) FROM race_counts)
ORDER BY race;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg))
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green'
  AND p.power_name = 'Flight'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id)
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = h.gender_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND h.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND h.weight_kg < 70;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN colour c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
WHERE s.height_cm = (
    SELECT MIN(height_cm)
    FROM superhero
    WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL AND height_cm > 0
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE LOWER(a.alignment) = 'neutral'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '';

WITH flagged AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0)
       OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5)
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS males,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS females
    FROM flagged
)
SELECT CAST(males AS REAL) / NULLIF(females, 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM counts;

SELECT p.ID,
       p.SEX,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
         - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))
         AS age_on_2026_10_09
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.GLU >= 180
        AND l."T-CHO" < 250
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT p.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
         - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS completed_age
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY p.ID
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN p.ID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID),
    2
) AS female_percentage
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE date(p.Birthday) < date('2026-10-09', '-55 years')
  AND date(l.Date) <= '2026-10-09'
  AND l.PT >= 14;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Description IS NULL
  AND l.CRP LIKE '%+%';

SELECT p.ID, l.Date, l.DNA
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(l2.DNA AS REAL))
      FROM Patient AS p2
      JOIN Laboratory AS l2 ON l2.ID = p2.ID
      WHERE p2.SEX = 'F'
        AND p2.Admission = '+'
        AND l2.DNA IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT MAX(CAST(L.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_anti_RNP
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.RNP IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(L.RNP) <> '';

SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 64 THEN p.ID
    END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN l.RNP IS NOT NULL THEN p.ID
    END), 0),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Thrombosis > 0;

SELECT
    P.ID AS patient_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', P.Birthday)) AS age_years
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.ID = P.ID
      AND L.LDH > 600
      AND L.LDH < 800
      AND (
          CASE
              WHEN L."U-PRO" LIKE '>=%'
                  THEN CAST(substr(L."U-PRO", 3) AS REAL)
              WHEN L."U-PRO" GLOB '[0-9]*'
                  THEN CAST(L."U-PRO" AS REAL)
              WHEN L."U-PRO" LIKE '%([0-9]%)'
                  THEN CAST(substr(L."U-PRO", instr(L."U-PRO", '(') + 1) AS REAL)
              ELSE NULL
          END
      ) >= 300
)
ORDER BY P.ID;

SELECT AVG(HCT) AS average_hematocrit
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date >= '1991-01-01'
  AND Date < '1992-01-01'
  AND HCT IS NOT NULL
  AND ("U-PRO" = '300' OR "U-PRO" = '>=300');

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.CPK < 250
  AND L.RNP <> 'negative'
  AND CAST(L.RNP AS REAL) > 4
ORDER BY P.ID;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.LDH >= 500
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS u
    WHERE u.ID = p.ID
      AND (
          u.`U-PRO` IN ('100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+2(100)')
          OR (u.`U-PRO` GLOB '[0-9]*' AND CAST(u.`U-PRO` AS INTEGER) >= 100)
      )
)
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND `First Date` >= '1998-01-01'
  AND `First Date` < '1999-01-01'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%';

SELECT p.Diagnosis AS overall_diagnosis,
       e.Symptoms AS symptom
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC,
         p.ID ASC,
         e."Examination Date" DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        MAX(CASE WHEN l.GPT >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS had_abnormal
    FROM Patient AS p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
)
SELECT
    CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' END AS sex,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM per_patient
WHERE had_abnormal = 0
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.RBC IS NOT NULL
      AND (l.RBC <= 3.5 OR l.RBC >= 6.0)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 0
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n')
   OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p');

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
       OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
);

WITH molecule_saturation AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
          AND b.bond_type <> '-'
      )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS all_single
  FROM molecule m
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN all_single = 1 THEN 'all_single_bonds' ELSE 'other_molecules' END AS molecule_group,
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_minus_noncarcinogenic
FROM molecule_saturation
GROUP BY all_single
ORDER BY all_single DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.element = 'cl' THEN a2.atom_id ELSE a1.atom_id END)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl';

WITH element_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT element, molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element IS NOT NULL
    AND molecule_id IS NOT NULL
),
rare_elements AS (
  SELECT element
  FROM element_molecules
  GROUP BY element
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
),
qualifying_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id, a.atom_id
  FROM atom a
  JOIN rare_elements r ON r.element = a.element
)
SELECT qa.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM qualifying_atoms qa
JOIN molecule m
  ON m.molecule_id = qa.molecule_id
 AND m.label = '+'
LEFT JOIN connected c
  ON c.atom_id = qa.atom_id
  OR c.atom_id2 = qa.atom_id
GROUP BY qa.molecule_id
ORDER BY qa.molecule_id;

SELECT ROUND(1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397') / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'), 0), 2) AS average_bonds_per_atom;

SELECT
    b.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN a1.element < a2.element
            THEN a1.element || '|' || a2.element
        ELSE a2.element || '|' || a1.element
    END) AS element_pair_count,
    m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_kind_symbol ASC;
